verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only adjacent AI capabilities. mParticle can score customers' likelihood to churn, convert, or grow and activate those audiences (docs-15). It also offers an assistant that suggests audience or journey logic from a stated goal, with a human still driving (docs-16, docs-22), and a real-time personalization API (docs-4). Nothing shows agents autonomously choosing messages, timing, or channels per customer. Missing for 10: autonomous per-customer decisioning agents, next-best-message/timing/channel selection, user-configurable guardrails for agent actions, measurable lift reporting or holdout testing for decisioning, independent corroboration.
